findings.reason: The Strang reference locator says §5.3, PDF pp. 3–6, covers forward-time and leapfrog schemes. Those pages cover leapfrog, its first-step initialization, and CFL analysis, but not the forward Euler update used in this item. The local growth calculation is valid; the source locator overstates the cited coverage. Correct the locator or cite a source that treats forward Euler ([MIT lecture notes](https://math.mit.edu/classes/18.086/2006/am53.pdf)).
